tasmā evaṃ samannāgato bhikkhu iminā paramena upasam'ādhiṭṭhānena samannāgato hoti. eso hi, bhikkhu, paramo ariyo upasamo yadidaṃ, rāgadosamohānaṃ upasamo.

16119.commentary: (ANa) upasamaṃ ārabbha uppannā anussati upasam'ānussati, sabbadukkh'ūpasam'ārammaṇāya satiyā etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. duvidho vā upasamo accant'ūpasamo ca khay'ūpasamo ca. accant'ūpasamo nāma nibbānaṃ, khay'ūpasamo nāma maggo. evam'etaṃ duvidham'pi upasamaṃ anussarantassa uppannā sati upasam'ānussatī'ti ayam'ettha attho.

examples.text: katamo ekadhammo? dhamm'ānussati … saṅgh'ānussati… sīl'ānussati… cāg'ānussati… devat'ānussati… ān'āpānassati… maraṇassati… kāyagatāsati… upasam'ānussati. ayaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ekadhammo bhāvito bahulīkato ek'antanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattatī'ti.
idh'āvuso, tathāgato ca loke uppanno hoti arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, dhammo ca desiyati upasamiko parinibbāniko sambodhagāmī sugatappavedito.

16122.commentary: (NIDD1) ajjhattam'ev'upasame'ti. ajjhattaṃ rāgaṃ sameyya, dosaṃ sameyya, mohaṃ sameyya, kodhaṃ… upanāhaṃ… makkhaṃ… paḷāsaṃ… issaṃ… macchariyaṃ… māyaṃ… sāṭheyyaṃ… thambhaṃ… sārambhaṃ… mānaṃ… atimānaṃ… madaṃ… pamādaṃ… sabbe kilese… sabbe duccarite… sabbe darathe… sabbe pariḷāhe… sabbe santāpe… sabb'ākusal'ābhisaṅkhāre sameyya upasameyya vūpasameyya nibbāpeyya paṭipassambheyyā'ti, ajjhattam'ev'upasame. (SNPa) ajjhattam'ev'upasame'ti attani eva rāg'ādi-sabbakilese upasameyya.

examples.text: ajjhattam'ev'upasame, na aññato bhikkhu santim'eseyya, ajjhattaṃ upasantassa, n'atthi attāṃ kuto nirattāṃ vā.

abhijānāmi kho pan'āhaṃ pitu sakkassa kamm'ante sītāya jambucchāyāya nisinno vivicc'eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharitā.

khattiyakulā ce'pi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti. so ca āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati. āsavānaṃ khayā samaṇo hoti.

āraddhavīriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
nihacca jāṇuṃ vanditvā, sammukhā añjaliṃ akaṃ, ehi bhadde'ti maṃ avaca, sā me āsu-upasampadā.
es'āhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ'ca bhikkhusaṅghañ'ca, labheyy'āhaṃ bhoto gotamassa santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampadan'ti.

tam'enaṃ rajako yasmiṃ yasmiṃ raṅgajāte upasaṃhareyya, yadi nīlakāya yadi pītakāya yadi lohitakāya yadi mañjeṭṭhakāya durattavaṇṇam'ev'assa aparisuddhavaṇṇam'ev'assa.

16164.commentary: (DNa) kām'ūpasaṃhitānī'ti kām'assādayuttāni. (MNa) kām'ūpasaṃhitā'ti ārammaṇaṃ katvā uppajjamānena kāmena upasaṃhitā. (ANa) kām'ūpasaṃhitan'ti kāmanissitaṃ duvidhe kāme ārabbha uppajjanakaṃ.

katame pañca? cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāma-upasaṃhitā rajanīyā… ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca kāmaguṇā. yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ime pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, ayaṃ kāmānaṃ assādo.

cattāri ṭhānāni naro pamatto, āpajjati paradāra-upasevī, apuññalābhaṃ na nikāmaseyyaṃ, nindaṃ tatīyaṃ nirayaṃ catutthaṃ.

16189.commentary: (BVa) upasobhathā'ti yathā gagane vijju ca majjanhike sūriyo ca upasobhati, evaṃ so bhagavā upasobhitthā'ti attho. samakan'ti sabbehi narasattehi samam'eva tassa āyu ahosī'ti attho.

examples.text: suphullo sālarājā'va, vijjū'va gagane yathā, majjh'anhike'va sūriyo, evaṃ so upasobhatha.

16191.grammar: prp of caus of upa √subh, caus, trans (+acc)

examples.text: atha kho taṃ, ānanda, cakkaratanaṃ samuddapariyantaṃ pathaviṃ abhivijinitvā kusāvatiṃ rājadhāniṃ paccāgantvā rañño mahāsudassanassa antepuradvāre atthakaraṇapamukhe akkh'āhataṃ maññe aṭṭhāsi rañño mahāsudassanassa antepuraṃ upasobhayamānaṃ.
